WHY RIVERTIDE

Built for the business
between seasons.

Martha’s Vineyard and the Mad River Valley run on different calendars. Their small businesses share a practical problem: deciding what a strong season can fund, and what it needs to carry. Rivertide is financial decision software for owner-operated teams of 1–3, built around that decision. It is not a bookkeeping tool.
